title: Final Expression for k
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the wave vector k in terms of frequency omega.

title: Final Expression for Threshold Frequency
description: Essential Criteria: The student must derive and present the correct expression for the threshold frequency omega_p.

title: Use of Damping Parameter
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly incorporate the damping parameter gamma in the derivation before setting it to zero.

title: Understanding of Permittivity
description: Important Criteria: The student must demonstrate understanding of how permittivity epsilon relates to the density of conduction electrons and the derived expressions.

title: Assumptions Clarification
description: Optional Criteria: The student should clarify any assumptions made during the derivation, such as the negligible variation of epsilon from epsilon_0.

title: Correct Units
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all derived expressions have correct units throughout the derivation.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common sign errors in the equations, particularly when dealing with forces and electric fields.

title: Clarity of Steps
description: Optional Criteria: The student should present the derivation steps clearly and logically to enhance understanding.
